models.title: Toggle Lever — a link folding toward dead centre
models.adaptation: The agent (OpenCode, deepseek-v4.1-flash) delivered ToggleJaw (120 parts) and honestly reported it blocked: the lever diverged and its link-removed control drifted. Audit found three geometry faults: the 5L lever, centre-pivoted, overlapped the yoke end beam at rest (bodies not jointed, so Jolt pushed them apart from the first step); the link shared the lever layer and swept over the pivot axle; and the yoke toggle reached the bracket pin from 66 degrees. Revised: 3L lever pivoted at its end hole on the top layer (tip 40 LDU from pivot, unchanged reach), link one layer above it on 4L/2L axles, 5L pivot axle stopping at the lever, guide axles 12L->10L without the +z/-z caps, bracket pin 3L->2L, the hinge-mounted anvil (free to swing on the pivot axis) removed. 112 parts. Kinematic clash sweep (editor overlap colliders, pins and axles included) clean from 0 to 89 degrees. Program: agent program-slow with reset timer, 30 deg/s, renamed.
models.supplierClaims: Agent: blocked; best hosted run law residual 28.3 mm rms; control failed (lever drifted 15 mm).
